title: SCA Minhag of the Week 307: "How Many Haqafot on Simhat Torah"

chapters.title: Introduction to Hakafot and World Customs
chapters.about: Simhat Torah hakafot, dancing around the tebah, and different community customs around the world.

chapters.title: Origins and the Aleppo Transmission
chapters.about: Mekubalim of Safed, Rabbi Chaim Vital, and Rabbi Chaim Cohen of Aram Soba.

chapters.title: The Aleppo Minhag of Seven Sets
chapters.about: Seven sets of seven hakafot, Kneset Kbirah in Aleppo, and the schedule across Shemini Atzeret and Simhat Torah.

chapters.title: Bet Nasi and Brooklyn Vestiges
chapters.about: Bet Nasi synagogue customs and Hacham Moshe Ashar's notes in Brooklyn.

chapters.title: Modern Practice in Community Synagogues
chapters.about: Practices in Shaare Zion, Bet Torah, and early minyanim today.

chapters.title: Conclusion
chapters.about: Summary of Aleppo's unique seven sets compared to other communities.

summary: This class explores the history and practice of hakafot on Simhat Torah, focusing in particular on the traditional custom in Aleppo of performing seven sets of hakafot. It discusses the origins of hakafot from the Mekubalim of Safed, the transmission of the custom through Rabbi Chaim Vital and Rabbi Chaim Cohen, and how various communities and local synagogues conducted these circles.
questions: How many times do different communities perform hakafot on Simhat Torah?
Where did the custom of hakafot originally come from?
How did the community in Aleppo perform seven sets of hakafot?
Which synagogues in Aleppo and Brooklyn preserved these specific customs?
